issue_context.title: Aligning top left has 0 padding between text and box line
issue_context.body: ### Description When adding text into boxes and aligning the text to one side (anything other than centered) the text pushes right up against the box lines. When the box is resized some padding is added. **Aligned (before resizing)** **After resizing** ### Environment MacOS 12 Firefox 102 Excalidraw+
comments: Yes, this  AFAIR is a regression, for other alignments the left/right padding gets removed.

review_comments: all but one test reports `[15, 20]` so I assume it doesn't quite work in test env?
